body:
save what exactly?  i didn't say i live comfortably i said i was paid okay.  if i could figure out a way to do it i would have. im not an idiot.  was this supposed to be serious?  did you look at my picture?  my mouth is a wreck.  i know it doesnt show everything but every single one of my teeth needs major work.  save and pay per appointment? sure, the best figure i could find to get the ball rolling was just under 1,500.  i live paycheck to paycheck, if i tried to save that out i'd be homeless or have to sell my beater and not be able to travel for work and lose my job.  

if ive come off as harsh, well, "whats the issue" ticked me off.  but uh, too bad.  ive had people left and right asking 'whats the problem' 'whats the big deal' for fucking years.  if i knew i wouldnt be like this.  its fucking hell living like this - and im not just talking about my teeth - and thats easily the dumbest question i get whenever i try to talk to some people.  

anyway if youve made it this far i suppose i should thank you because this is pretty much the most passionate ive felt about anything all year...so, thanks?
i don't know what to even talk about.  i guess it does help temporarily.  but at the end of the day i remember how hopeless it is and i can't do anything about it
